## Problem and behavior

Describe the user-visible problem, scope, and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated checks and results are listed.
- [ ] Visual or manual checks and unavailable checks are identified.
- [ ] Privacy: fixtures are synthetic; reports, screenshots, paths, tokens and session identifiers are reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG are updated; breaking changes and migration steps are stated.
- [ ] External references and behavior claims are supported or explicitly marked unverified.

## Limits and risks

Describe any remaining limitations, compatibility concerns, and rollback considerations.
